taskDelivery.reason: Complete acceptance and per-hunk atomic ownership cannot be established from Conventional subjects and owning-plan paths alone. Existing bounded delivery remains evidence, not a whole-task certificate.

subsets.name: bounded-opc
subsets.reason: Bounded ZIP/OPC read and validated publication; encrypted and multi-disk packages reject. Full schema validation is not provided.

subsets.name: original-dialect
subsets.reason: Admit Strict and Transitional dialects and edit only supported structures in the original dialect. No implicit conversion or full schema certification.

subsets.name: macro-free-kinds
subsets.reason: Read and create original DOCX and DOTX packages with explicit kind. Macro-enabled mutations reject; suffixes do not establish package kind.

subsets.name: opaque-xml-retention
subsets.reason: Namespace-aware bounded edits retain unmodified opaque XML. Recognition does not authorize semantic edits; affected unsupported structures reject.

subsets.name: declared-compatibility-profile
subsets.reason: Bounded logical reads use the declared understood-namespace profile. Unselected alternate branches remain preserved; unknown MustUnderstand requirements and affected unsupported branches reject. No blanket extension support.

subsets.name: explicit-inventory-packing
subsets.reason: Sorted authenticated VFS records, retained kind/dialect and exact opaque bytes; complete graph validation and one deterministic staged publication. No scanning or ambient files.

subsets.name: exclusive-archive-extraction
subsets.reason: Whole namespace admission, exact all/media-only bytes and optional pretty XML into a new explicit tree; conditional VFS directory/file creation and explicit partial-output consent. No rollback or live-model claim.

subsets.name: bounded-comparison
subsets.reason: Explicit package payload/XML or story text/structure scope. Both inputs share cumulative retention, XML, work and change budgets; no rendering, ID renumbering or host I/O.

subsets.name: record-template-filling
subsets.reason: Exact tagged body control bindings, typed records and native nested rows/sections; four repeat levels, 1,000 items per region and cumulative budgets. Empty arrays retain reusable cleared prototypes. IDs and occurrence-local relationships remap before one publication; no expressions or host access. Template utility batches and whole model APIs remain pending.

subsets.name: selective-sanitization
subsets.reason: Fixed-order explicit properties/comments/revisions/links/objects actions with exact effects and retained gaps; unsupported affected review/objects reject before publication. No comprehensive privacy or recoverability promise; utility batches remain unsupported.

subsets.name: seeded-selected-dummy-text
subsets.reason: Required seed, paragraph-local original vocabulary, explicit count or whitespace-delimited logical span count; retain formatting and nontext data. Not anonymization; no time, randomness, networking or external generator. Generic utility batches and live owners remain pending.

subsets.name: bounded-content-removal
subsets.reason: Explicit paragraph/run scalar endpoints and marker inclusion; whole paragraphs, runs and tables. Section breaks, required empty paragraphs and all resource graphs survive. Affected annotations, notes, fields, review and graphics reject; no cross-container ranges, resource garbage collection or utility batches.

subsets.name: signature-structure-inventory
subsets.reason: Exact declared OPC origin, relationship and part roles, including external metadata; cryptographic validity is unknown.

subsets.name: explicit-signature-removal
subsets.reason: Complete safe signature graph and content-type removal with exact reports. Default mutations reject signed input; no regeneration or generic utility batch execution.

subsets.name: inert-object-inventory-extraction
subsets.reason: OLE/package relationships, shape-bound previews and shared resources; exact bounded VFS payload extraction. No activation, binary decoding or linked fetch. Macro/protection state remains unknown unless declared; external targets are redacted.

subsets.name: physical-equation-inventory
subsets.reason: Package-global physical outer math units with inert stored/global properties and inactive/opaque preservation.

subsets.name: bounded-equation-fragments
subsets.reason: Explicit whole-paragraph append or same-root unit replacement using matching-dialect bounded fragments. Full schema, evaluation, conversion, layout, rendering, utility batch execution and live math models remain unsupported.

subsets.name: physical-diagram-inventory
subsets.reason: Package-global physical role candidates and native bindings with inert graph closure, including orphan parts. Preserve-only snapshots imply no semantic editing, activation, rendering, external acquisition or live model support.

subsets.name: opaque-graphics-preservation
subsets.reason: Eligible unknown graphics and extensions remain separately qualified opaque observations, including inactive alternatives. Unknown-only evidence does not establish a known diagram; utility batch execution remains unsupported.

subsets.name: physical-chart-part-inventory
subsets.reason: Package-wide definitions, including unreferenced parts, with ordered plot groups, indexed string/numeric/multilevel caches and inert formula metadata. Cached freshness unknown; no active occurrence, formula engine, workbook validation or rendering claim.

subsets.name: opaque-chart-preservation
subsets.reason: Extension/wrong-profile definitions remain explicitly opaque. Workbook/style/color descriptors and physical graph references stay inert; utility batch and live models are unsupported.

subsets.name: native-shape-inventory
subsets.reason: Active native, Office and VML shape/group occurrences with hierarchy, stored metadata, text-box story owners and physical section references. No rendering, geometry editing or live drawing models.

subsets.name: simple-text-box-assignment
subsets.reason: Whole simple admitted ungrouped box text assignment replaces run formatting and retains paragraph properties/geometry. Preserving scoped text editors reuse carrier authority. Nested/grouped, linked, opaque, multiple-body and shared-header edits reject; no implicit shared edits or utility batch execution.

subsets.name: inline-png-jpeg-insertion
subsets.reason: Original bounded utility insertion of admitted PNG/JPEG bytes into one whole paragraph or admitted body/cell/explicit header/note block container. Native per-axis DPI with independent 72 fallback, explicit physical units, checked contain/cover/stretch and decorative/alt intent. Known suffixes must match bytes; retained exact media and capability publication. Five-format header metadata characterization does not imply insertion of GIF/BMP/TIFF. Floating authoring, SVG without a supplied fallback, pixel decoding, rendering and drawing occurrence models remain unsupported. The separate static SVG/fallback insertion subset is qualified under F35.
